module: Drag race zone editor (strip zone or lane zone), following the same principle as the crawl editor boundaries. It relies on the gameplay/sites/zone class: mouse vertex selection, adding/inserting vertices, moving and rotating with the editor's axis gizmo, optional terrain snapping, undo/redo via editor.history. init() returns an editor instance; zoneFromData/zoneToData convert between a serialized table and a Zone object.
usage:
local zones = require('/lua/ge/extensions/editor/dragRaceEditor/zones')
local ed = zones.init()
ed:setZone(zones.zoneFromData(strip.stripZone), {type='stripZone', strip=strip})
-- every frame: ed:draw(mouseInfo)
ed:syncBack()
notes: Shortcuts: Shift+click adds a vertex (the first click adds a vertex if the zone is empty), Alt+click inserts at the middle of an edge, Ctrl+click adds a vertex to the selection.
The target is {type='stripZone', strip=...} or {type='laneZone', strip=..., lane=...}; syncBack writes the serialized zone to strip.stripZone or lane.zone and marks the strip _dirty.
In dragging(), the gizmo offset is divided by 2 (posOffset = delta/2): behavior as-is in the code, to re-check if the vertices seem to follow the gizmo at half speed.
snapToTerrain is enabled by default (height via core_terrain.getTerrainHeight).

init.desc: Creates and returns an initialized zone editor instance (class C).

returns.desc: instance with the methods setZone, clearZone, syncBack, draw...

C.desc: Zone editor returned by init(). Fields: zone, target, currentVertices (selected vertices), currentPlane, snapToTerrain.

zoneFromData.desc: Static function: builds a Zone from a serialized table (deep copy; vertices and customFields default to empty, so an empty zone is allowed).

returns.desc: Zone instance, nil if data is nil

zoneToData.desc: Static function: serializes a Zone via zone:onSerialize().

setZone.desc: Sets the edited zone and its target; resets the vertex selection.

clearZone.desc: Forgets the current zone and target.

syncBack.desc: Writes the zone back to strip.stripZone or lane.zone, marks the strip _dirty and flags unsaved changes. No effect if there is no zone or target.

findVert.desc: Among objects {pos, index}, finds the one hit by the mouse ray (selection radius = camera distance/40) that is closest to the camera; also draws the spheres (orange if already selected).

dropToTerrain.desc: Projects a position onto the terrain height (core_terrain.getTerrainHeight).

tryInsert.desc: Finds the hovered edge midpoint; on click, inserts a vertex there (history action "Insert Zone Vertex"). Requires at least 2 vertices.

input.desc: Handles mouse input: vertex addition (Shift or empty zone), insertion (Alt), otherwise single or multiple (Ctrl) vertex selection.

updateTransform.desc: Places the axis gizmo at the centroid of the selected vertices (or at the point of the current plane).

beginDrag.desc: Start of gizmo move: stores the starting positions.

dragging.desc: During gizmo move: translates (with terrain snapping) or rotates the selected vertices around their centroid.

endDragging.desc: End of move: re-snaps to terrain if enabled and records the history action "Manipulate Zone Vertices".

draw.desc: To be called every frame in zone edit mode: updates/displays the gizmo, handles input and draws the zone as debug.
